**In one line**: A US judge reportedly ruled that a supply chain risk designation imposed on Anthropic was unlawful and vacated it.

### Key points
- The court found Anthropic's supply chain risk designation to be "illegal and baseless," according to Nextgov/FCW.
- Such a designation classifies a vendor as a risk within a government procurement context; the ruling reportedly nullifies its effect.

### Why it matters
The case signals that an agency's move to flag an AI company as a procurement or security risk can be subject to judicial review. It may shape how AI vendors approach public-sector deals and regulatory challenges.
